parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Hybrid Cloud WAF cluster.

> This parameter is required only when WAF is deployed in hybrid cloud mode. Call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query the IDs of Hybrid Cloud WAF clusters.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: ObjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the threat detection or security event for which you want to query operation records.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the WAF instance belongs.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the operation record. Valid values:

- **abnormal**: threat detection.

- **event**: security event.
